title: First run: the launch finish's Tour started event may be dropped if Clarity has not started yet
evidence: From the owner's review after PR 1608. A finish at launch runs from .onAppear(perform: decideFirstRun) at ios/HealthRoadmap/App/RootView.swift:107, through finished(), which fires analytics.event(.tourStarted) at RootView.swift:241. Analytics starts in the WindowReader background at RootView.swift:62-65, and ios/HealthRoadmap/App/Analytics.swift:52-54 makes event a no-op until started. The run order of onAppear and WindowReader is unknown, so the event may be dropped and the usage signal undercount launch finishes. No effect on what the person sees. US-57 usage signal. Done: Analytics holds up to 20 events fired before Clarity starts (Phase.waiting) and sends them once it starts; never under the tests or without an id
